name: Dropdown
label: Dropdown
description: Custom select dropdown with keyboard navigation, disabled options, and error states.

props.name: value
props.description:
Currently selected value, controlled. Leave undefined to let the
dropdown keep its own selection, seeded from `defaultValue`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Selected value on first render when uncontrolled (`value` undefined).

props.name: groups
props.description: Optional grouped options — when provided, renders groups with labels and separators

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected value

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the list is open, controlled. Leave undefined to let the dropdown open and close itself.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the list starts open when uncontrolled (`open` undefined).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Fires when the list opens or closes, with the new state.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Legacy change handler, kept for backwards compatibility.

props.name: name
props.description:
Form field name. When set, the selected option's `value` submits with an
enclosing form through a hidden input (nothing while no value is set,
nothing while disabled), as Combobox does. Also the fallback for the
element id (`id || name || label`).
